evidence.observation: Smooth monotonic warming of column stages; profile stays ordered with top stages stable
Head temperatures steady near 67.5 °C, consistent with a stable light-cut plateau
Differential pressures stable (~0.8 / ~2.0 mbar), no flooding or blockage
Reflux ~0.32 L/h and distillate ~0.52 L/h steady

args.missing_evidence: A composition/purity measurement of the distillate cut; also clarification of T701's very high (~359 °C) reboiler reading relative to the rest of the profile.
